name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Generalist | Critical Thinking, Written Communication & Cross-Domain Analysis

Writes clearly and analyzes data as a matter of course: technical audits, structured reporting, and client-facing documentation are part of the regular workload. Currently builds and evaluates AI agent workflows directly, including reviewing and refining model outputs against defined criteria, work that maps directly onto training and evaluating AI systems.
